paper.title: Are queries and keys always relevant? A case study on Transformer wave functions

results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 6 × 6 · J₂/J₁ = 0.5 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.5; no constant shift
results.source_location: Table "Results for the J2-J1 Heisenberg model at J2/J1 = 0.5" (table:energies), left (6 x 6) panel, row T5
results.eligibility_evidence: Final mean variational energy per site of the ViT state optimized with stochastic reconfiguration (Table energies), with the Monte Carlo error in parentheses.
results.notes: Spin-1/2 J1-J2 model (Eq. J1J2_ham), L x L lattice with periodic boundaries; the Monte Carlo moves keep the total Sz = 0 (appendix on sampling). Architecture h = 10 heads, d = 60, patch b = 2, n_l = 4 layers.
